intro: Atlantis invite warmth and elegance into your meals. With rich walnut tones, smooth edges, and solid build, our Atlantis is designed to bring people together—day after day.

features.title: Walnut veneer top
features.text: The rich walnut-finished MDF top gives your dining room a refined and cozy look that’s easy to style and made to last through every season.

features.title: Strong rubberwood frame
features.text: Crafted with a durable rubberwood base, this table offers lasting strength and support, making it ready for everyday use and special occasions alike.

features.title: More legroom, more comfort
features.text: Thoughtfully placed legs at the table's ends give everyone generous leg space, making family meals and long dinners feel even more comfortable.

features.title: Smooth and safe edges
features.text: Rounded corners and soft edges bring elegance while ensuring safety—ideal for homes with kids or tight dining spaces.

features.title: Setup made simple
features.text: Its knockdown construction makes transport and setup easy, so you can enjoy your table sooner with less effort and stress.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
